rationale:
bugs_open/178's edit_live fix (commit 08d0515f3, live v1.0.1247) joins each ready section to its existing page_components row by exact slot_name == section name. Live verification on 2026-08-04 found ONE page where that join legitimately misses: guide-independent-strategy's prose was stored under slot_name 'generic-text-block', but this build's plan/selection resolved the same position to 'article-body' — a different component. The exact-name join found nothing, so page-content-writer fabricated a fresh section from the item's guidance text alone and dropped the original prose — the ORIGINAL bug (bugs_open/178), reached by a route the first fix does not cover. Diffed directly, not inferred: 3637 chars of stored prose replaced by 3262 chars of wholly different text (new opening, headers, a fabricated 'Last reviewed: October 2023' line).

Measured fleet-wide before investing further, per this bug's own standing instruction: of 127 pages with a current site_plan and existing page_components rows, 3 (2.4%) already carry a stored slot_name absent from their current plan's own component_name list (gripper-cycle-time-estimator: 'faq' and its tool slot; guides-index: 'guide-list'; index (00ff3af5's site): 'image-hover-card-grid'). That is a lower bound on exposure — it only counts pages ALREADY mismatched today, not pages that could newly mismatch on their next rebuild. Query and full working preserved in NOTES_work_item_routing_columns.md's 2026-08-04 entry.

Root cause of the mismatch itself (why a build's resolved component name can differ from what an earlier build stored) is NOT re-investigated or changed by this submission — bugs_open/178's own final update leaves that open as fix candidate 3 (fix the underlying instability). This submission is candidate 1 from the same list: make the READ-ONLY enrichment step load_current_section_content tolerant of a resolved-name miss, by falling back to 'the page's current prose slot' when the pairing is unambiguous. It changes nothing about how sections are named, selected, or written — only what this one opt-in step attaches to the writer's input.

plan.summary: load_current_section_content_action.go (bugs_open/178's edit_live channel, opt-in via spec.mode='edit_live', default OFF for every other caller) gains a second, narrower match: when exactly one ready section misses the exact slot_name join AND exactly one still-unclaimed page_components row on the page is prose-sized (>=500 stripped chars, reusing the shrink guard's own minShrinkGuardChars/shrinkGuardTagStripper), that row's rendered_html is attached to that section as existing_content_html. Two or more of either side is left unmatched — no guessing. Recorded structurally as edit_live_meta.fallback_matched (kept distinct from the exact-match count), which is also the first fleet-wide instrumentation of how often this drift class actually fires, on every future edit_live build.

edits.rationale: This is the one place a page's stored prose is joined to the current build's section plan for editing. The exact-match loop is untouched (same behaviour, same test coverage); the fallback is additive and only ever fires inside the already-opt-in edit_live gate, so its blast radius is bounded to the two live emitters that set mode='edit_live'.

Three new cases: the unambiguous fallback fires and attaches the right content; two unmatched sections leave both unattached (no guessing); a small leftover slot (below minShrinkGuardChars) is not treated as a plausible prose match. Mutation-proven: reverting load_current_section_content_action.go to the pre-fallback version (git stash of exactly that file) fails all three new cases with the exact expected/got mismatch, while every pre-existing case in the same file still passes unchanged.
edits.sketch: See file — reuses the existing newInsertMock/sqlmock scaffolding and the assertIsThePlan helper already in this file; no new test infrastructure.

grounded_in: THE FAILURE, DIFFED: bugs_open/178's 2026-08-04 update — page 2a347990-c152-4fa2-8acb-a39a5f74f4a9 (vetcomparison guide-independent-strategy), stored slot_name 'generic-text-block' (page_component_history id c5769938, 3637 chars, snapshot taken at write time), post-run page has only slot 'article-body' (3262 chars, wholly different prose, diffed word-for-word).

THE MECHANISM, READ FROM THE COMPONENT ROWS: content_components has exactly one active row per section_type here — generic-text-block (section_type='generic-text-block', created 2025-11-21, 'Fallback component for any unmatched section') and article-body (section_type='article-body', created 2026-04-08, description literally 'Component needed for section type \"article-body\" on page \"tool-gripper-payload-calculator-guide\"' — minted for an unrelated page). site_plan_sections for this page (single plan, is_current=true, created 2026-07-17) has always named this position 'article-body'. content_components carries no site_id/page_id — it is a fleet-shared library, so a component minted for one page becomes selectable for any other page whose plan names the same section_type.

THE FLEET-WIDE MEASUREMENT (2026-08-04, run against the live DB): of 127 pages with a current site_plan and existing page_components rows, 3 already carry a stored slot_name absent from their plan's own component_name list — gripper-cycle-time-estimator (site 00ff3af5-dad8-4770-9f70-3edc267a3c92: slots 'faq' and 'tool-gripper-cycle-time-estimator', plan lists only call-to-action/generic-text-block/hero), guides-index (site 1244516d-014d-421c-88c6-090bb1e9552a: slot 'guide-list', plan lists content-listing/hero), and index (site 5fe8785b-223d-41a3-88ee-c07187622381: slot 'image-hover-card-grid', plan lists six other names). Query: WITH plan_names AS (SELECT sp.site_id, sps.page_name, array_agg(DISTINCT sps.component_name) FROM site_plans sp JOIN site_plan_sections sps ON sps.plan_id=sp.id WHERE sp.is_current GROUP BY 1,2), stored AS (SELECT p.id, p.site_id, p.name, pc.slot_name FROM pages p JOIN page_components pc ON pc.page_id=p.id WHERE pc.slot_name IS NOT NULL AND pc.build_status <> 'removed') SELECT ... WHERE NOT (slot_name = ANY(planned_names)).

THE EXISTING PATTERN THIS REUSES: minShrinkGuardChars (500 stripped chars) and shrinkGuardTagStripper already define 'prose-sized' for save_sections_shrink_guard.go's per-slot floor (bugs_open/178, council e64f8576 APPROVED). Reusing the same package-level constant/regexp rather than inventing a second definition of 'prose-sized' — grep-verified, both symbols are unexported and package-scoped, no import needed.

MUTATION EVIDENCE: `git stash push -- load_current_section_content_action.go` then running the three new tests against the pre-fallback code fails all three (fallback_matched read as <nil>/want 1 or 0-with-content-attached), confirming they exercise the new branch and not something already true of the old code. `git stash pop` restored the fix; full package `go test ./platform/orchestration/actions/...` is green afterward.

BUILD AND FULL PACKAGE TEST: `go build ./platform/orchestration/actions/...` clean; `go test ./platform/orchestration/actions/...` green (all pre-existing load_current_section_content tests unchanged and passing, including the bugs_open/192 regression tripwire TestLoadCurrentSectionContent_NeverWraps).
plan.risks:
SCOPE IS BOUNDED TO THE OPT-IN GATE: this whole action is a structural no-op unless spec.mode='edit_live' (2026-08-02 owner ruling: new authority on a shared seam ships opt-in, default OFF), and today exactly two emitters set it (create_tool_cross_link_items.go, apply_gap_plan_action.go's applyAddToPage). No other page build is touched.

A WRONG PAIRING IS STILL POSSIBLE IN THE UNAMBIGUOUS CASE: if a page happens to have exactly one unmatched ready section and exactly one unrelated large prose slot that is not really 'the same section' by any human judgement, the fallback would attach the wrong prose as editing context. This cannot delete or overwrite anything — it only enriches what page-content-writer is given to work from — so the worst case is a stray, irrelevant paragraph offered as context for one section on one build, still subject to every existing write-time guard (shrink floor, completeness floor) before anything is saved. Fleet measurement above found 3 candidate pages; none showed more than one unclaimed prose-sized slot at once, so this scenario is not yet observed, only theoretically possible.

DOES NOT FIX THE ROOT CAUSE: why a build's resolved component name can differ from an earlier build's stored slot_name is unchanged and unexplained by this submission — it remains bugs_open/178's open fix candidate 3. A reviewer should treat this as closing the SYMPTOM (the writer fabricates instead of edits) for the unambiguous case, not as a claim that component-identity drift itself is fixed or bounded.

A REVIEWER SHOULD CHECK: whether 500 stripped chars (minShrinkGuardChars) is the right prose-sized floor for THIS purpose too, or whether attaching context for editing should use a different threshold than refusing a shrink — the two are reused as one constant here for exactly the reason grounded_in states (avoid a second definition of 'prose-sized'), but the reviewer may judge the two questions are not actually the same question.
